milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the soul torch already exists in the scene and the player must navigate to it and visually identify it. The soul torch is placed at spawn-relative (0, 0, 7) inside a small inner room within the stone brick building. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the inner room (spawn is 7 blocks away, so the rule is NOT satisfied at spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the soul torch, confirming visual identification rather than just passing nearby.
